column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 2: all three tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (claimTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases is PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision), so these three have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here. 3 skips, not a subtest group -- each test is its own top-level skip, same shape as a-keyless-worker-cannot-recognise-sealed-history.tsv's pair.
same three tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
